name: plaiiin-status
description: Operate a Plaiiin Status server from Claude. `status-server-ops` covers the infrastructure model, the probe and command libraries both kinds are imported from, and the wiring traps that fail as silence; `status-server-api` drives a live board over its REST API (tree, history, workflow records, versioned probe and command authoring). Targets any deployment via STATUS_URL + STATUS_API_KEY.
